source: Environment and Climate Change Canada — MSC GeoMet LTCE

story.description: Bancroft, ON recorded 11.6 °C. It exceeded the previous record high minimum temperature of 7.2 °C from 1922.

highlights.text: 102 records broken, 5 tied. The most common type was record high minimum temperature (54 of 107).
96 records broken, 1 tied. The most common type was record high maximum temperature (71 of 97).
12 records broken. The most common type was daily precipitation record (8 of 12).
6 records broken. The most common type was record high maximum temperature (3 of 6).
